With the upcoming release of macOS 27 Golden Gate later this year, Apple continues its beta testing efforts and has rolled out the fifth beta to developers. Here's a preview of what's included in this update.

Apple Releases macOS 27 Beta 5

Three weeks ago, Apple released macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 4, followed a few days later by the corresponding public beta version.

Apple is now rolling out macOS Golden Gate beta 5, continuing to fix bugs and improve performance ahead of this year's official release.

macOS 27 Golden Gate introduces a brand-new Siri application and a redesigned Siri AI. The system also features an AI-powered new version of the Shortcuts app, allowing users to create shortcuts through natural language commands, along with a prompt-based Safari extension authoring tool.

Additionally, macOS 27 Golden Gate adds new Golden Gate-style wallpapers and screensavers, while restoring the window and app corner radius to a fixed size. This change reverses the approach taken in macOS 26, where the system adjusted the corner radius based on the content of each window or app menu bar.

macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 5 is build number 26A5406e. We're currently diving into this new beta and will share more findings with you later.

How to Install macOS 27 Golden Gate Beta

Here's how to install macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 5:

  • Back up your Mac
  • Open System Settings
  • Go to General → Software Update
  • Click the 'i' icon next to 'Beta Updates'
  • Select 'macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta' from the dropdown menu in the top-right corner
  • Click Done

Have you discovered any new features in this macOS 27 Golden Gate beta? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
